## Phase 1: standard review (faffter-noon-review)

Signal: pass. No standard findings.

## Adversarial findings — not obtained (mandatory chain outage)

The run ledger makes the adversarial second opinion mandatory, and no opinion was obtained. The only configured backend, openai/fixture-model, returned HTTP 429 (fixture rate limit); the all-rate-limited exhaustion (exit 12) was remapped by the helper to exit 9 (mandatory-chain-outage). The build has no adversarial review and must park before a PR is opened.

### critical: Mandatory adversarial review chain outage

Location: .faffrc.yaml
Every backend in the `adversarial` chain for the code_review consumer was rate-limited (openai/fixture-model, HTTP 429), so the mandatory second opinion for FAFF-7001 was not obtained.
Action: Wait for the rate limit to clear or add a backend with spare quota to the adversarial chain, then rerun the review.
